list.name: user_id
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, '' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT user_id AS __text, user_id AS __value FROM users ORDER BY __text

list.name: user_plan
list.label: Subscription Plan
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, '' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT subscription_plan AS __text, subscription_plan AS __value FROM users ORDER BY __text

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE (${user_plan:sqlstring} = '' OR subscription_plan = ${user_plan:sqlstring})

panels.title: Average Rating ($user_plan)
panels.description: Average of each matching user's own average rating (from user_rating_avg, computed by the user-rating-avg job over reporting-db.ratings) - only counts users who've rated at least once.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(r.avg_rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating FROM user_rating_avg r JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE (${user_plan:sqlstring} = '' OR u.subscription_plan = ${user_plan:sqlstring})

SELECT country, count(*) AS user_count FROM users WHERE country IS NOT NULL AND (${user_plan:sqlstring} = '' OR subscription_plan = ${user_plan:sqlstring}) GROUP BY country ORDER BY user_count DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Average Rating per User ($user_id, $user_plan)
panels.description: All-time avg rating per user, computed by the user-rating-avg job over reporting-db.ratings (no time window - covers every rating a user has ever given).

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.user_id, r.avg_rating, r.rating_count, r.updated_at FROM user_rating_avg r JOIN users u ON u.user_id = r.user_id WHERE (${user_id:sqlstring} = '' OR r.user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) AND (${user_plan:sqlstring} = '' OR u.subscription_plan = ${user_plan:sqlstring}) ORDER BY r.avg_rating DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: User Detail ($user_id, $user_plan)
panels.description: Filtered by the User and Subscription Plan pickers above - shows every user when both are "All". avg_rating/rating_count/mood/movie_percentage/series_percentage/top_genre/top_device/top_language are NULL for a user missing the underlying activity (no ratings, no watches, etc). movie_percentage/series_percentage are each in [0, 1] and sum to 1 - share of this user's all-time watches that were movies vs. series (user-series-movie-ratio job). top_genre/genre_watch_count/watches_used are the user's most-watched primary genre over their last USER_TOP_GENRE_RECENT_N watches (user-top-genre job) - a recency rank, not a time window. top_device/top_language are all-time frequency, tie-broken by most recent watch, not a recency window (user-top-device-language job - see its README).

targets.rawSql: SELECT u.user_id, u.age, u.gender, u.country, u.subscription_plan, u.account_status, u.signup_date, u.primary_device, r.avg_rating, r.rating_count, m.mood, m.avg_recent_rating, smr.movie_watch_count, smr.series_watch_count, smr.movie_percentage, smr.series_percentage, tg.top_genre, tg.genre_watch_count, tg.watches_used, dl.top_device, dl.device_watch_count, dl.top_language, dl.language_watch_count FROM users u LEFT JOIN user_rating_avg r ON r.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_mood m ON m.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_series_movie_ratio smr ON smr.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_top_genre tg ON tg.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN user_top_device_language dl ON dl.user_id = u.user_id WHERE (${user_id:sqlstring} = '' OR u.user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) AND (${user_plan:sqlstring} = '' OR u.subscription_plan = ${user_plan:sqlstring}) ORDER BY (substring(u.user_id from 2))::int LIMIT 200

panels.title: Users by Mood ($user_plan)
panels.description: good/average/bad, from the user-mood job's classification of each user's average of their last 3 ratings. Only counts users who've rated at least once.

targets.rawSql: SELECT m.mood, count(*) AS user_count FROM user_mood m JOIN users u ON u.user_id = m.user_id WHERE (${user_plan:sqlstring} = '' OR u.subscription_plan = ${user_plan:sqlstring}) GROUP BY m.mood ORDER BY user_count DESC

panels.title: Users by Top Genre (Top 10, $user_plan)
panels.description: How many users currently have each genre as their top genre - see User Detail above for the per-user definition (most-watched primary genre over their last USER_TOP_GENRE_RECENT_N watches).

targets.rawSql: SELECT tg.top_genre, count(*) AS user_count FROM user_top_genre tg JOIN users u ON u.user_id = tg.user_id WHERE (${user_plan:sqlstring} = '' OR u.subscription_plan = ${user_plan:sqlstring}) GROUP BY tg.top_genre ORDER BY user_count DESC LIMIT 10
